frequency_question: What proportion of Senate confirmations for executive nominees are completed within 22 calendar days of initial formal submission?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to Senate-confirmed executive branch positions submitted to the Senate; excludes judicial nominations and part-time board members.
provenance_note: claimed 2 hits but 4 of 10 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 10 named representative samples from a total population exceeding 300 major executive appointments.
known_gaps: Sampling relies on prominent agency head confirmations rather than exhaustive processing of every minor sub-cabinet post.
skeleton: Total standard executive confirmations examined in past four administrations, filtered by those achieving floor votes under 22 calendar days from receipt.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 10 sampled representative high-profile agency nominations
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules regarding committee notice periods and floor debate limits remain stable across congressional terms but reset with new Senates.
